newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Boral sells German-based operation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Boral sells German-based operation.

text.p: Boral Ltd said on Monday that it had sold its European roof tile operations, based in Germany.

The company said that as part of a resutructuring of its European businesses, its roof-tile operation had been sold to Koramic-Wienerberger Dachprodukte GmbH, a joint venture of Koramic Building Products of Belgium and Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie, the large Austrian building materials company.
Boral said it would realise A$40 million from the sale.
Abnormal losses in relation to the sale would be of the same magnitude.

Tony Berg, Boral's managing director, said: "We decided to sell the German roof tile business after an extensive review of this loss-making operation. This move is consistent with the stated strategy to improve returns for Boral shareholders from our European businesses."
Included in the sale are the clay roof tile plants at Langenzenn and Riesa-Forberge and the concrete roof tile plant at Langburkersdorf.
The clay roof tile plant at Straubing, the closure of which was announced some months ago, is excluded from the sale.
The sale is conditional on approval by the German anti-trust office, Boral said.

Following the sale, Boral's remaining businesses in Europe will be the substantial clay brick operations in The Netherlands, Germany and Poland and some minor quarry and other resource assets, it added.
